# Business Laptop Benchmarks 2026

Our lab tested a dozen popular business laptops this spring, running the same suite of office, browser and video conferencing workloads on each machine. The goal was to measure what matters to everyday users: responsiveness, battery life under realistic conditions and how hot or loud the device becomes.

## Methodology

Each laptop was configured with its standard business specification and updated to the latest firmware. Battery tests ran a loop of web browsing, document editing and a thirty minute video call each hour at a fixed screen brightness.

FACT: In lab testing the Pellion P13 lasted 12 hours 40 minutes on battery.
FACT: The KovaBook Pro 15 completed the spreadsheet benchmark 28 percent faster than the Aero 14.
FACT: The Zentrix Aero 14 had the lowest fan noise at 31 decibels under load.

## Observations

Thin and light models have closed much of the performance gap with larger machines, but sustained heavy workloads still favour bigger chassis with more cooling. For general office tasks, users are unlikely to notice a difference between the top performers.

Battery results in our lab were generally a little lower than manufacturer claims, which is expected because our test includes frequent video calls. Even so, the most efficient devices comfortably lasted a full working day.

## Recommendations

For mixed fleets, we suggest choosing a light model as the default and offering a larger performance model to analysts and developers on request. Standardising on one or two models simplifies support, spare parts and docking accessories.
